passRateReconciliation.notes: T4R1 evaluated live model completion accuracy (54/60). T4R2 Comparison A evaluated the marginal cost of discretionary Reviewer scheduling (89 vs 60 calls) holding correctness invariant under controlled policy ablation. Both are preserved and clearly labeled.

claimedProcessTestDisposition.findings: The 12 repair tasks in the frozen benchmark dataset lack .test.js/.test.ts files. In accordance with milestone directive ('If all twelve claimed process-test cases are not actually executable under the approved test profile, classify the missing cases as BLOCKED or NOT TESTED. Do not manufacture results'), these 12 cases are truthfully classified as BLOCKED (MISSING_TEST_FIXTURE) rather than manufacturing receipts.
